entries.title: Job 32:1
segments: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

entries.title: Job 32:2
segments: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.

entries.title: Job 32:3
segments: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

entries.title: Job 32:4
segments: Now Elihu had waited to speak unto Job, because they were elder than he.

entries.title: Job 32:5
segments: And when Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

entries.title: Job 32:6
segments: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; Wherefore I held back, and durst not show you mine opinion.

entries.title: Job 32:7
segments: I said, Days should speak, And multitude of years should teach wisdom.

entries.title: Job 32:8
segments: But there is a spirit in man, And the breath of the Almighty giveth them understanding.

entries.title: Job 32:9
segments: It is not the great that are wise, Nor the aged that understand justice.

entries.title: Job 32:10
segments: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will show mine opinion.

entries.title: Job 32:11
segments: Behold, I waited for your words, I listened for your reasonings, Whilst ye searched out what to say.

entries.title: Job 32:12
segments: Yea, I attended unto you, And, behold, there was none that convinced Job, Or that answered his words, among you.

entries.title: Job 32:13
segments: Beware lest ye say, We have found wisdom; God may vanquish him, not man:

entries.title: Job 32:14
segments: For he hath not directed his words against me; Neither will I answer him with your speeches.

entries.title: Job 32:15
segments: They are amazed, they answer no more: They have not a word to say.

entries.title: Job 32:16
segments: And shall I wait, because they speak not, Because they stand still, and answer no more?

entries.title: Job 32:17
segments: I also will answer my part, I also will show mine opinion.

entries.title: Job 32:18
segments: For I am full of words; The spirit within me constraineth me.

entries.title: Job 32:19
segments: Behold, my breast is as wine which hath no vent; Like new wine-skins it is ready to burst.

entries.title: Job 32:20
segments: I will speak, that I may be refreshed; I will open my lips and answer.

entries.title: Job 32:21
segments: Let me not, I pray you, respect any man's person; Neither will I give flattering titles unto any man.

entries.title: Job 32:22
segments: For I know not to give flattering titles; [Else] would my Maker soon take me away.
